headline: Oman Rescues Crew From Burning RITI Tanker
deck: Oman says it evacuated 25 crew from the Panama-flagged crude tanker RITI in the Strait of Hormuz as Iran reported other tanker incidents.
body: Oman’s Maritime Security Centre said it evacuated 25 people from the burning crude tanker RITI in the Strait of Hormuz. [E1] [E2]

Oman said RITI was flying the Panamanian flag, while MarineTraffic identified it as a crude oil tanker. Oman’s statement said the vessel had been targeted and caught fire, and that the crew received medical care. [E3] [E7] [E8]

Iran said four tankers attempting to use routes it calls unauthorised were halted. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said two of those vessels, in the eastern and western parts of the strait, had encountered incidents and stopped in waters south of it. [E4] [E5]
Hours later, the IRGC said two more tankers, each carrying more than 2 million barrels of oil, exploded and caught fire after hitting mines while using an unauthorised route. [E6]
